name: APU_3_Pairing_or_Syncing_User_Accounts_with_Devices_and_Data_Repositories
title: APU.3 Pairing or Syncing User Accounts with Devices and Data Repositories (Header)
description: This category is about consumer verification of all devices to which they wish to pair or sync data.

statement.label: APU.3#77
statement.requirement: The app SHALL require the user to have authenticated identity to the app and have an active session before pairing an external device to an app account.

statement.label: APU.3#78
statement.requirement: The app SHALL display a screen asking the user to confirm that the device will collect information about a specific, named person (account holder or proxy subject) before a device is paired with the app to collect information about that individual.

statement.label: APU.3#79
statement.requirement: The app SHALL provide a utility function permitting the person who pairs a device with an individual to un-pair the device and individual.

statement.label: APU.3#80
statement.requirement: The app SHALL state what data will be collected by the device and how the device data is used before a device is paired with the app to collect information about a specific individual, optionally including a link to an informational page.

statement.label: APU.3#81
statement.requirement: IF data for more than one person can be collected by the app/device pair THEN the app SHALL ask the account holder to confirm the person for whom data will be collected by the device before data is collected and transmitted.

statement.label: APU.3#82
statement.requirement: IF a syncing option is included within the app (e.g., same app data synchronized across smartphone and tablet devices) THEN the app SHALL provide the user with an option to consent to the syncing process.[1]
